intent: Stack several fields and field sets in one column and give responsive Fields the width they lay out by.
typical_uses: The body of a form, stacking its Fields
The fields inside a FieldSet, under its legend

dont_use_when.situation: Several fields that share one title
Joining a control with addons or buttons into one bordered unit
Joining separate buttons into one attached row

mounted_in.container: the consuming application's own form or section element
mounted_in.note: The usual outermost part of a form built from this family.

invariants.text: FieldGroup is an inline-size container named field-group: a responsive Field inside it switches to the horizontal layout when this element, the nearest such ancestor, is at least 28rem wide, whatever the viewport width.
FieldGroup takes the full width of its container and stacks its direct children in a column with a --space-6 gap. It renders no role.

good.title: Fields stacked in a group, one of them responsive

bad.title: A FieldGroup used as a titled section
bad.why: FieldGroup renders a plain div with no role, so the aria-label names nothing a screen reader announces as a group. A titled section is a FieldSet with a FieldLegend.
